llm.summary: This skill is a scoped email experiment planning and read-out guide that uses user-provided campaign data and does not show hidden or unrelated behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to design email A/B, multivariate, send-time, and hold-out experiments and evaluate completed test results; the instructions and data requests match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly limits itself to experiment design and statistical read-out, treats exported data as untrusted, asks for missing inputs, and avoids taking over email writing or broader quality-gating tasks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains a single non-executable SKILL.md file, with no bundled scripts, installers, or automatic setup behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It may use a local Python connector command for statistical calculations and mentions optional keyed ESP APIs, but both are disclosed and proportionate to analyzing user-provided ESP results.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The only persistence is an optional dated memory summary under a scoped email directory, and the skill explicitly says not to write memory without asking.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that the skill can analyze exported ESP or ecommerce performance data you provide, and it can optionally save a summary if you approve. Only authorize optional ESP API access or memory writes when you are comfortable sharing that campaign data in the skill host.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector:clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; artifact review supports that result.
[staticScan:clean] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the single markdown-only artifact.
[VirusTotal:clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this is supportive telemetry, not the basis for the verdict.
